description: This file defines a React component 'PostEditor' used for editing and creating blog posts, including form inputs for title, slug, tags, status, and content, with functions to handle form submission and slug generation.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Converts an input string into a URL-friendly slug by lowercasing, trimming, removing non-word characters, replacing spaces with hyphens, and collapsing multiple hyphens.

methods.name: PostEditor
methods.description: React component for creating or editing a blog post, managing form state, handling submission, and rendering form UI.
